svg.title: SpanSynth-Edit Fig. 1: retro 04 Electric Sunset palette
svg.desc: Two-panel figure with frame-aligned model input and MIDI Span encoding. Piano and strings form spans; the drum contributes an onset only. Row permutations preserve the event set. Frame features are stacked into M and supplied to the model. Instrument images are embedded; diagram elements and text remain editable vectors. Palette 04: Electric Sunset, inspired by https://piktochart.com/blog/retro-90s-color-palette/. Tints and darker line colors preserve print legibility. Purple #9568B8 and teal #3A8D9F separate instrument events within the warm palette.
